validation.notes: Repaired migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot() in packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts: the collision guard `if (existsSync(newPath)) return;` aborted the entire legacy-session batch, so every file sorted after the colliding one stayed in the agent root. It is now `continue`, which skips only the colliding file, leaves both copies byte-for-byte intact (no overwrite, no delete) and keeps migrating the rest of the batch. The regression loads the real module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs (loadMigrations, real fs/path, caller-owned temp agentDir) and asserts: (1) with a deterministic in-order collision, the colliding file remains in the agent dir with its original bytes while the pre-existing target copy is unchanged and all later files migrate with their own content; (2) a second run is idempotent - identical session-directory contents and only the untouched colliding file left behind; (3) malformed JSON, empty, non-session and cwd-less headers are never moved or mutated across repeated runs; (4) a clean batch fully migrates and reruns do not duplicate; (5) a collision does not stop files bound for a different cwd's session directory. Verified red/green: with the original `return` the script exits 1 with AssertionError 'migration aborted early: legacy-2.jsonl was left behind after the collision on legacy-1.jsonl'; with the fix it exits 0. No dependencies or network were used (Node 24 type stripping + VM modules); the only environment caveat is the expected Node ExperimentalWarning for stripTypeScriptTypes/VM modules.
